details.description: Introducing Sofy's revolutionary anti-bacterial sanitary pads, designed to provide you with unparalleled comfort and protection, even on your heaviest days. Crafted with a deep absorbent sheet that locks in flow until the last layer, these extra-long pads with wings offer a secure and leak-free fit. Infused with natural ingredients, the green sheet provides 99.9% bacteria protection against Escherichia coli, Staphylococcus aureus, and Candida albicans, ensuring long-lasting hygiene and freshness. The ultra-slim and gentle design, coupled with a delicate perfume tree fragrance, will leave you feeling confident and comfortable throughout the day. Environmentally conscious, these biodegradable pads are kind to both you and the planet, allowing you to choose comfort without compromising on sustainability. Experience the ultimate in protection, freshness, and peace of mind with Sofy's Antibacteria Ultra-Thin Sanitary Napkins.
details.usageInstructions:
Peel off release paper from the back of the pad.
Stick the pad on panty and press firmly.
Peel off release paper from the wings, fold the wings around panty and press firmly.
After use wrap used pad in paper and throw in a dustbin.
Do not flush pads, it may cause clogging of drains.

SOFY SOFT TAMPONS - REGULAR( For Normal Flow)
Thanks to Sofy Tampons, now you can spend even your menstruation days like any and every other day in your life. A perfect choice for active, modern and sporty girls, Sofy Tampons provide you with the much needed comfort you have always craved for. Tampons are products designed to absorb the menstrual flow by insertion into the vagina during menstruation. Freedom From Leakage:-These tampons provide absorption in an extremely sensitive area of your body, so there are no worries or discomfort when it comes to problems like stuffiness during use.
Usage : For Regular Menstrual Flow
details.usageInstructions:
1.Insert the rounded end of the applicator into the vaginal opening ensuring that the string is left outside
2.Once the top half of the applicator is fully inside, push the applicator handle in. This will help in placing the tampon securely and in the right place. Pull out the plastic casing.
3.When you have to change the tampon (which should be done before 8 hours), pull out with the help of String. The V Shape it takes makes removal easier
